text: The program is integrated within the NSW Government’s disaster recovery architecture, complementing other initiatives like the Resilient Homes Program. It features innovative barge-based operations for efficient access to riverine sites and involves multi-agency co-funding and co-delivery, spreading cost and risk. Community engagement through door-knocking and pop-up offices ensures that the program's priorities align with local needs.
